form.paragraph: This study aims to define a rupture-risk index based on a 1,000-sample cost-effective FSI study focused on coronary plaque rupture risk. The goal is to identify the factors that drive this index, providing insights into the mechanisms behind plaque rupture.
novelty: Introduction of a new rupture-risk index (ΔPSS / strength)
Cost-effective approach using a large sample size (1,000 samples)
Focus on the drivers of coronary plaque rupture risk
form.outlineQuick:
1. Introduction to coronary plaque rupture and its significance
2. Overview of the FSI study methodology
3. Definition of the rupture-risk index
4. Analysis of factors driving the rupture-risk index
5. Discussion of implications for clinical practice
6. Conclusion and future directions
